_comment: PA2 Section 4 demo queries. Three intended-good (medical/wellness topics likely covered by MedOverNet) and three intended-bad (out-of-domain or ambiguous, used to motivate Section 4.1 reranker).

queries.label: good_1_blood_pressure
queries.query: Kateri so simptomi visokega krvnega tlaka?
queries.expected: Articles about hypertension symptoms (glavobol, vrtoglavica, krvavitve iz nosu).

queries.label: good_2_diabetes_diet
queries.query: Kakšna prehrana je primerna pri sladkorni bolezni tipa 2?
queries.expected: Articles on diabetes diet, low glycemic index foods, sugar substitutes.

queries.label: good_3_insomnia_help
queries.query: Kako naravno premagati nespečnost in izboljšati spanec?
queries.expected: Sleep hygiene, melatonin, herbal remedies, relaxation tips.

queries.label: bad_1_ambiguous_pain
queries.expected: Too short and ambiguous; expected to return generic medical chatter.

queries.label: bad_2_out_of_domain_legal
queries.query: Kakšne so pravne posledice neplačila prometne kazni v Sloveniji?
queries.expected: Out-of-domain (legal). Expected to return loosely related civic/administrative content if any.

queries.label: bad_3_acronym_no_context
queries.expected: Acronym with multiple meanings (medicine + finance). Expected to surface unrelated content; reranker should at least prefer medical interpretations if any segment matches.
